variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.body: A union has called a strike in {colony}. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.body: A strike has been called by a union in the colony. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.body: The colony has a union call for strike action. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
